import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
from collections import Counter
pkts=[]
for i in range(1024):
    frames=[{'type':'CRYPTO','offset':(i*30+k)%5000,'data_hex':'aabb'} for k in range(30)]
    pkts.append({'level':'H','pn':i,'auth':True,'frames':frames})
dgs=[{'t':0,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':pkts[i:i+16]} for i in range(0,1024,16)]
dgs.append({'t':5,'op':'key','level':'H','action':'install'})
traces=[{'id':'t','config':{'early':False,'overlap':'first','buffer_packets':1024,'idle_ms':0,
  'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,'max_data':4611686018427387903,
  'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':{'I':[],'H':[],'A':[]}},'events':dgs}]
req=json.dumps({'version':1,'traces':traces}).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],input=req,capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f cpu %.2f rss %.1fMB'%(time.time()-t0,u.ru_utime,u.ru_maxrss/1024))
r=json.loads(p.stdout); res=r['results'][0]
print(Counter(p['status'] for p in res['packets']))
print('crypto', [(c['level'],c['highest'],len(c['contiguous_hex'])//2) for c in res['crypto']])
# also check the ref agrees
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work'); import ref
exp=ref.run(json.loads(req))
print('ref match', exp==r)
EOF
